model: Exactly three sources form a diet with nonnegative DRY-MASS fractions summing to1. Source amounts specify moles of the LIGHT isotope(12C or14N)per gram dry matter,not total elemental mass or dietary fraction. For each element,delta=1000*(heavy/light ratio divided by its fixed reference ratio minus1). Ratios mix by the supplied LIGHT-isotope amounts;therefore diet delta is their corresponding light-isotope-weighted average. No other source,isotope fractionation or loss is allowed beyond the explicitly known additive consumer-minus-diet calibration shifts.
target: Infer the three dry-mass fractions in source order. Also solve the incorrect model that directly dry-mass-averages both source delta values after applying the same calibration shifts. Return those unconstrained naive fractions without clipping or renormalization and whether they form a nonnegative diet. Classify whether the actual light-isotope-weighted model identifies a unique nonnegative diet.
scope: Conditional isotope mass-balance exercise with exact supplied ratios and known calibration. It does not establish actual dietary causation,real discrimination factors or field uncertainty.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled abstract biological measurement/model fixture;not a real protein,diet or intervention claim.
